test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which was the new scheme announced during Budget 2025-26 that targets 100 low productivity districts and focuses on enhancing agricultural productivity, crop diversification, sustainable practices, irrigation and post-harvest storage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana was announced during the Union Budget 2025-26 to address agricultural productivity challenges in 100 low-productivity districts.
 
• The scheme aims to enhance agricultural productivity through crop diversification, sustainable practices, and modern agricultural techniques.
 
• A special focus is placed on improving irrigation infrastructure and ensuring post-harvest storage facilities to minimize crop losses.
 
• The scheme also promotes the adoption of climate-resilient farming practices to ensure long-term sustainability in agricultural activities.
 
• It is designed to uplift farming communities, especially in underdeveloped areas, and contribute to rural economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Crop Diversification:** This refers to the practice of growing a variety of crops to improve soil health, reduce dependency on a single crop, and increase agricultural income.
 
• **Sustainable Agriculture:** It involves farming practices that meet current food needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs, focusing on eco-friendly techniques.
 
• **Irrigation Infrastructure:** Proper irrigation systems help in water management for farming, ensuring that crops receive adequate water during critical growth periods.
 
• **Post-Harvest Management:** This includes activities such as storage, processing, and transportation of crops to prevent spoilage and improve marketability.
 
• **Climate-Resilient Farming:** These are agricultural methods designed to withstand the adverse effects of climate change, such as drought-tolerant crops and water-conservation techniques.
